text: 锂产业链风险管理工具添新，证监会同意广期所氢氧化锂期货和期权注册 中国证监会已同意广州期货交易所氢氧化锂期货和期权注册，这将与现有碳酸锂品种形成协同，进一步丰富锂产业风险管理工具。
text_en: New lithium industry chain risk management tool added, CSRC approves GFEX lithium hydroxide futures and options registration. The CSRC has approved the registration of lithium hydroxide futures and options on the Guangzhou Futures Exchange, which will synergize with the existing lithium carbonate contract and further enrich risk management tools for the lithium industry.
